messages:
alex: heads-up — starting rollout of v3.8.1 to prod-usw in 15m. change window until 02:00 UTC. auto-rollback set: error_rate >= 3% sustained 5m. watch p95 and kv-cache logs. release notes: https://redwood.dev/release-notes/v3.8.1

liam: copying. what's pinned for dedicated pools? any manual pin plan?

jen: release-notes still missing the 'kv-cache hotfix' entry. can someone patch? cc @product

deploy-bot: [deploy] roll started: v3.8.1 -> prod-usw. canary 5% for 10m. telemetry: p95 baseline=220ms. notify on deviation >25% :bell:

maya: +1 on patching notes. also, if canary shows kv-cache mismatch, fallback path is pin to v3.7.9 and drain new workers.

liam: how do we pin? paste command pls

sam: pin command: 
```
redwoodctl release pin --pool dedicated-usw --version v3.7.9 --reason "kv-cache fallback"
```
then `redwoodctl rollout cancel --release v3.8.1` to stop remaining traffic

alex: added a short checklist in thread: 1) confirm canary telemetry for 10m 2) if >=3% errors, wait 2m to rule out noise 3) if sustained /customer-impacting/ -> manual pin + rollback + notify customers 4) ops-notification to #incidents

ops-bot: created incident INC-4217: 'prod-usw canary monitor' linking thread

jen: notes updated and pushed to CDN.

liam: can we lower auto-rollback threshold to 2% for this deploy? kv-change is sensitive.

alex: yes lowering for canary slice only. deploy-bot, set threshold 2% for canary

deploy-bot: ack. updated auto-rollback threshold for canary -> 2% sustained 3m

maya: can we pre-stage the rollback message for customers (short): "We're investigating degraded latencies in prod-usw for requests hitting kv-cache; mitigating by rolling back to a previous version" — approve?

jen: approve

sam: prepped runbook snippet for manual rollback. paste below:
```
# Manual rollback runbook
1. pin dedicated pools to v3.7.9
2. cancel rollout and drain new nodes
3. verify KV mismatch logs: /var/log/kvcache/*.log
4. run smoke tests: `make smoke-prod-usw`
5. update customers + close incident
```

alex: canary telemetry just crossed 2.5% error_rate (5m). I'm watching. If 3% hit, i'll start manual pin.

liam: oncall heads up @olivia

olivia: i'm watching metrics, ready to assist on rollback

deploy-bot: [alert] canary error_rate=3.1% (sustained 3m) — rolling to halt.

alex: executing manual pin + rollback now. running commands

alex: `redwoodctl release pin --pool dedicated-usw --version v3.7.9 --reason "rollback: kv-cache regression"`

deploy-bot: [action] pin applied to dedicated-usw -> v3.7.9

alex: `redwoodctl rollout cancel --release v3.8.1 --force`

deploy-bot: [action] rollout canceled. starting rollback workers -> v3.7.9. estimated time 4m

maya: starting smoke tests

sam: smoke tests passing on read/write paths, p95 back to baseline 210ms

ops-bot: incident INC-4217 updated: mitigated, rollback executed, monitoring

jen: sending customer note now. draft: "We experienced a latency regression related to kv-cache in prod-usw; we rolled back to v3.7.9. No data loss. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." 

alex: thanks everyone. please file a retro card and tag eng-releases for follow-up (kv-cache compatibility test in preflight)

liam: will open ticket and assign to eng-runtime

olivia: clearing watches in 10m

alex: closing thread. :thumbsup:
